summary: When the gateway Operator reconciliation ends (`Ansible-runner exited successfully`), unidle with `idle_aap: false`, wait for the `aap-gateway` pod, delete old `HTTPPort`, `Route` and `ServiceNode` objects via `aap-gateway-manage shell`, and set `AAP_CONTROLLER_POD` to the `aap-controller-task` pod.
questions: How do I unidle AAP on OpenShift?
Clean up old gateway routes after migration
How do I know the gateway operator finished reconciling?

answer_card.title: Unidle and clean gateway endpoints
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc patch ansibleautomationplatform aap --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"idle_aap":false}}'
for i in HTTPPort Route ServiceNode; do
  oc exec -it deployment.apps/aap-gateway -- aap-gateway-manage shell \
    -c 'from aap_gateway_api.models import '$i';print('$i'.objects.all().delete())'
done
export AAP_CONTROLLER_POD=$(oc get pods --no-headers -o custom-columns=":metadata.name" | grep aap-controller-task)
```
